# 2026 United Kingdom heat waves

There were several heat waves in the United Kingdom in 2026.

## June heat wave

### Meteorology

A high-pressure system moved over the United Kingdom in mid-June 2026, bringing hot and sunny weather. Temperatures peaked on 16 June 2026, when a new record for the highest temperature in June in the United Kingdom was set. Lingwood, Norfolk recorded 37.0 °C (98.6 °F), breaking the previous record of 35.6 °C (96.1 °F) set at Southampton Mayflower Park on 23 June 1976.
